A3.rationale: Named legislation, DPIA, segregation-of-duties and AI-risk controls are strong; no explicit attacker/threat model is stated.

A6.rationale: Shadow-mode test design per capability is defined with stop criteria, but no evaluation harness exists and model choice is not yet justified.

A7.rationale: Agent boundaries (recommend/draft/reconcile/flag) and handoffs are well defined; new PAS 2035 human-role hypothesis does not add autonomous AI behaviour evidence.

B3.rationale: No demo exists yet; only a plan for a future non-production demonstrator is described.

B4.rationale: Sponsor discovery questions anticipate challenge areas, but there is no live Q&A evidence to assess composure under pressure.

B5.rationale: No timed delivery or rehearsal evidence exists in the repository.

B6.rationale: New owner-direction table and PRD Open Questions section extend the cross-referenced, traceable documentation; still dense and reader-effort heavy, holding it short of 5.

B7.rationale: New owner-direction table rigorously labels each item's evidence status (owner-accepted, declined, illustrative benchmark); still no measured demo or live data storytelling.

C1.rationale: Stakeholders, constraints and quantified value at stake remain explicit and interrogated; new OQ-001 to OQ-008 table deepens accountable-function framing further.

C2.rationale: Written role-agent challenge shows disagreement being recorded and addressed, but there is no live session evidence of real-time listening or disagreement navigation.

C3.rationale: Multiple new 'Declined: no evidence base exists to model this responsibly' entries and unresolved-until-verified OQ status reinforce the honest, non-fabricating stance already credited.
